segments.textOriginal: What do you enjoy doing before work?
I go strength training three mornings a week.
Do you have a particular goal at the gym?
I'm working toward my first strict pull-up.
That sounds like a good challenge.
Yes, I like keeping a simple training log.
How has your training been going?
The pull-up work is progressing, thanks.
I'm preparing for my first 10-kilometre race in December.
Have you changed your weekly schedule?
I'm trying to fit easy runs around the gym sessions.
How are you balancing your gym work and the 10K plan?
I keep the runs easy after heavy lifting days.
I'd like to run the full distance comfortably.
Thanks for sharing. I hope training goes well.
